name: AttributionBench
description: AttributionBench is a comprehensive benchmark compiled from various existing attribution datasets to evaluate automatic attribution evaluation methods, specifically assessing whether claims in generated responses are fully supported by cited evidence.
reputation: A useful benchmark for attribution checking that has seen some use in evaluating citation faithfulness and support verification methods, though it is not yet a widely standardized leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Highlights challenges in automatic attribution evaluation even for state-of-the-art LLMs; fine-tuned GPT-3.5 achieves around 80% macro-F1.
